patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.chiefComplaint: Passed out, belly and back pain
presentation.quote: I passed out cold at the store. Now I've got this deep tearing pain in my belly going through to my back, and it kind of throbs. Something feels really, really wrong.
presentation.triageNote: 71-year-old male who fainted before developing severe abdominal pain radiating through to his back. He is diaphoretic with a pulsatile abdominal mass, heart rate 118, and blood pressure 88/54.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 1 is appropriate because hypotension with syncope, severe abdominal and back pain, diaphoresis, and a pulsatile mass requires immediate lifesaving intervention.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This older adult has shock physiology and a classic pattern for catastrophic intra-abdominal vascular bleeding.
clinical.acuityReason: Blood pressure 88/54 with tachycardia and diaphoresis indicates decreased perfusion requiring simultaneous resuscitation and definitive surgical mobilization.
expectedResources: Immediate large-bore IV access and blood-product resuscitation
keyFindings: Severe abdominal pain radiating to the back
teachingPoints: Unstable patients with this pattern should not be delayed for routine CT imaging.
Resuscitation and operative mobilization must occur in parallel.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Immediate blood-product resuscitation and vascular intervention would be required, with emergency operative or endovascular repair.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: hunched, both hands clutching his belly
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 71-year-old man, pale and sweaty, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: hunched forward, both hands clutching his belly. Expression: frightened and in severe pain. Clearly visible: pale sweaty skin and both hands gripping his abdomen. No text, no logos.
